name: TBS All Star Kanshasai Vol. 1: Chou Gouka! Quiz Ketteiban
summary: TBS All Star Kanshasai vol.1 – Chou Gouka! Quiz Ketteiban is the Playstation 2 version of the popular japanese TV Show (aired in Japan since 1991) hosted by Shinsuke Shimada & Wakako Shimazaki. The game features, 20 different characters to choose from, up to 4 human players to play at the same time using the multitap function and a few mini games.
